notes.title: Wishlist Arima now!
notes.content:
[u][b]Arima has a page on Steam, it's time to add it to your wish list![/b][/u]

Hello there! My name is Xavi and I'm one of the developers of the game!
I’m here to bring you awesome updates of Arima.
I can't wait to show you everything we've working over the last 2 years.
Feel free to tell what you think about the game!


As a sneak peek I leave here our soundcloud page to hear some of the music of Arima: https://soundcloud.com/3d2entertainment
